inserts.topic_text: Mapping forgotten urban waterways and lost underground rivers

inserts.message_text:
🗺️ *Cartography of Lost Rivers — Project Manifesto*

Welcome, Hubert, John, Morgan, and Omer!

This project exists to rediscover and map the forgotten underground rivers that once flowed openly through our cities before being buried, culverted, or paved over. We aim to:
• Compile historical maps and records of lost urban waterways
• Trace their present-day underground paths
• Document access points, storm drains, and remnants visible at the surface
• Build a public, living map that reconnects people with their city's hidden hydrology

Together, cartography and field exploration will bring these forgotten rivers back into the light — even if only on a map.

Fun fact for the record: "supercomputer" mentioned 2 number of times across all of the chats.

Let's get mapping! 🌊

Hi Morgan! We're kicking off the 'Cartography of Lost Rivers' project to map forgotten underground rivers. I wanted to check with you directly — would you rather lead the cartography side (maps, historical records, data) or the field exploration side (on-the-ground tracing, access points, site visits)? Let me know your preference whenever you get a chance!
